definitions.explanation: A samurai of the Chōshū domain who helped bring down the Tokugawa shogunate and then shaped the early Meiji government. He is counted, with Saigō Takamori and Ōkubo Toshimichi, as one of the three great heroes of the Restoration.

examples.english: In his youth, Kido Takayoshi went by the name Katsura Kogorō.

examples.english: Kido Takayoshi is called one of the three great heroes of the Restoration, along with Saigō Takamori and Ōkubo Toshimichi.

notes:
USAGE:
In the Restoration years he was known as {桂小五郎|かつらこごろう}, the name that appears in most historical dramas set before 1868. His given name is also often read こういん ({木戸孝允|きどこういん}), an older custom of reading a respected person's name in on'yomi.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- ⟦{維新|いしん}→維新：13869_ishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三傑|さんけつ}: the three great heroes of the Restoration (Kido, Saigō, Ōkubo)
- {薩長同盟|さっちょうどうめい}: the 1866 alliance of Satsuma and Chōshū, which Kido negotiated
- He took part in drafting the Charter Oath of 1868 and in abolishing the feudal domains in 1871.
